title: My Niece Stole My Widow's Pension, Sold My Pens, Gave Me $3,700. So I Voided The Sale.
description: When my niece forged a dissolution to steal my $640,000 vintage pen collection and handed me a $3,700 inkwell check, I thought I had lost everything until I found our original agreement rolled inside a 1920s Montblanc. I voided the sale, reclaimed the studio, and now she polishes nibs in a smock that says 'Scratched Out Trust' while every pen box prints her fraud docket number. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #JusticeServed
thumb_text: I VOIDED THE SALE AND NOW SHE POLISHES NIBS
pinned_comment: What would you have done if your niece handed you a $3,700 inkwell check after stealing $640,000 worth of pens from the studio you poured your widow's pension into? Share your story in the comments.
